abstract: A survey of nearly 2,000 higher education workers across over 1,800 institutions found widespread AI tool adoption (94%) but significant gaps in policy awareness and risk perception. While the vast majority of staff and faculty are using AI in their work, only about half are aware of their institution's AI policies, and two-thirds identified six or more urgent AI-related risks, including concerns about job loss.
keyFindings: 94% of higher education workers use AI tools for work.
Only 54% of higher education workers are aware of institutional AI policies.
67% of respondents identified six or more urgent AI-related risks, including job loss.
Survey included 1,960 staff and faculty across 1,800+ institutions.
methodology: Survey of 1,960 staff and faculty across 1,800+ higher education institutions.
